evidenceBoundary: SIMULATED / HEURISTIC USABILITY REVIEW, NOT REAL USER TESTING. No person took part. The five personas from product/report.json were role-played as cognitive-walkthrough evaluators by an AI agent; the "test rig" is the uncalibrated numerical simulator (sim/, activetether@0.1.0) run headless and on a scratchpad copy with extra persona scenarios (rider plans and activity traces are user-tester ASSUMPTIONS). Scores are evaluator judgements, not measurements. Real user tests (T12, T14, T16, T18, all wearing/lift/chairlift trials) are physical, NOT_RUN and need user authorisation. M-070 NOT_RUN, G-MATURE closed. This file does not write project/plan.json; sim/ was not modified.
inputs: research/active_tether_2026_10_20/product/report.json (journey J1-J10, PM-M01..M14, product metrics, personas P1-P5, T01-T18)
sim/js/concepts/activetether/* (model.js mode machine, detect.js, index.js scenarios + demo)

method.browserRig: sim/ copied to the scratchpad, served by tools/serve.mjs, opened headless (Playwright + Chrome, SwiftShader WebGL) at concepts.html?c=activetether&m=demo&lang=en; demo seeked through all 7 stages; all 12 shipped test scenarios run in test mode; 5 persona scenarios added to the scratchpad copy only (patch in scripts/scratch_sim_scenarios.patch).
method.scriptedRuns: scripts/persona_runs.mjs on the scratchpad copy: persona ride plans x {calm, head 3, tail 3 / cross 3 / cross 6} x seeds 11-13 through the shipped buildResult() pipeline; falls via simulateSkier(fallAt); activity traces through the shipped detector (detect.js). Raw output: sim_persona_runs.json.
method.scoring: Each journey step scored 1-5 on effort, confusion, fear/safety, social acceptability on the piste, failure recovery (5 = best / no problem). Heuristic (Nielsen visibility of status, error prevention, recovery) + cognitive walkthrough ("will the user know what to do / what happened?").

uxMetricsAdded.quiverOutRideS: seconds of riding with the quiver deployed (O.quiver > 0.5)
uxMetricsAdded.towedOnSnowWhileRidingS: seconds of riding in LANDED/RETRIEVE (flyer on a short line, on or near the snow)
uxMetricsAdded.standDeviceBusyS: seconds standing while the device is not STOWED/DOCKED
uxMetricsAdded.perStop.modeAtRestart: device mode at the moment the rider pushes off again

whatTheUserSees_demo.note: Demo = 30 s recreational carve + 21 s stop, 1 m/s cross wind, seed 11 (the friendliest case). Screens in screenshots/demo_*.png.

timeline.obs: Quiver rendered diagonally from the right hip up past the shoulder blade - a 0.55 m rigid tube across the back; that is the chairlift/backrest profile.
Start detected ~0.8 s after push-off; quiver swings out behind the pelvis. Nothing tells the rider (no light/sound in the design).
Launch on the straight glide; short-line phase visibly swings. The rider must keep a straight line for >=0.6 s - he would naturally start turning.
Line at ~50 deg; PiP shows a usable rear-high full-body shot. Even in this friendly case the run reports avail 16.1 %, pxMed 242 px, KE 19.1 J (fail).
Hockey stop; flyer deep-stalls and drops behind.
Flyer dragged over the snow toward the rider for ~8 s on a magenta line at ankle height - a trip line for anyone skiing past.
Capture + fold; the rider stood ~12 s before locked. In the shipped ensemble the same step is p50 13.9 s / p90 31.3 s.

simulatorUiObservations: The demo shows only the favourable path; failures that dominate persona runs (launch failure, drag-on-snow while riding, lost flyer, refusals with the quiver out) are only visible if one constructs those cases. Recommend demo stages for refusal, failed launch and short-stop-and-go.
The rider-facing interface (beep/haptic/LED, strap button, app) is not represented at all, so refusal comprehension (PM-M08/T12) and status visibility cannot be walked through in the sim.
For non-run scenarios the setupTime row shows the 48-case ensemble value (22.19 s) next to single-run numbers - confusing for reviewers.

setupTime passes (10-22 s) in runs where the next ride is lost because the device was still retrieving: the shared metric does not charge lost footage or towing-while-riding. Proposed product metrics: nextRideFilmedAfterStop, towedWhileRidingS, quiverOutWithoutFlightS.

J1 car gear-up.note: Lumbar unit + 0.55 m quiver over a normal jacket; 0.91 kg is fine. No screen: "single beep = ready" is unverified; she will not know if the flyer is charged.

J2 lift (chair/T-bar/gondola/carpet) wit.note: Beginner areas use magic carpets (0/40 detector starts in our traces - good) and T-bars/platters: the bar goes exactly where the lumbar unit and the hinged quiver sit; nobody has checked this. On a chair she cannot sit back fully (65 mm plate ASSUMED acceptable, engineering).

J3 top / getting ready.note: Nothing to do (ops 0) - but she gets no prediction whether it will fly at her speed.

J4 push-off / launch.note: At 5 m/s the gate (1.35 x 4.93 m/s stall = 6.65 m/s apparent) never opens in calm or 3 m/s tail: 0 launches, but the quiver swings out and stays out for 68-72 s of 77 s riding (READY). At 7 m/s (or 5 m/s + 3 m/s headwind) it tries and fails: 2-3 launch attempts/run, 1-2 failures, flyer drops and is dragged on the snow 19-50 s per 79 s of riding.

J5 ride / film.note: Usable footage 0 % (5 m/s calm/tail), 9-21 % (5 m/s head 3), 0-25 % (7 m/s). KE is low (<=18.6 J max, mostly <7 J) - the one thing that is safe at her speed. Head clearance 0.36-0.67 m in the 7 m/s calm case (fails >=1.0 m).

J6 planned stop (and wanting to keep goi.note: Many stops; each flown stop costs 5-17 s standing (up to 42 s). 5 m/s + head 3: the 5.8 s stop was docked by the restart (5.1-5.2 s). 7 m/s: after the 5.2 s stop the device was still CAPTURE/RETRIEVE/BRAKE at restart in 4/6 cases.

J7 fall.note: Sim (4-5 m/s fall): fall detected 0.60-0.64 s after the event (target <=0.5 s), body force <=9.7 N, head clearance >=0.98 m in the 6 s after the fall. Backward sit-down falls onto the rigid lumbar unit/quiver are NOT modelled (engineering top risk: breakaway <=60 N).

J8 restart after stop/fall.note: Max 2 launches per ride; after failed attempts the rest of the run is unfilmed with no explanation. 1 of 9 7 m/s runs ended in MANUAL stow (+20 s, hands behind her back).

J9 walk / skate / queue / skin / shuttle.note: Queue/walk/chair 0 starts (results.json, synthetic). Slow beginner drifts 2.5-3.5 m/s on a green: 24/40 detector starts -> quiver swings out next to other beginners. Ski bus down to the village: 39/40 bus descents start AND pass the wind gate (results.json) -> launch attempt inside the bus.

J10 end of day.note: Footage offload (PM-M12) not modelled; little footage to offload.

J11 charging / drying overnight.note: Two cells (32 Wh pack + 1.65 Wh flyer); wet line drying reminder needed; no charger spec.

J1 car gear-up.note: Fine: 0.91 kg, 2.28 L, nothing to assemble.

J2 lift (chair/T-bar/gondola/carpet) wit.note: Chair downloads: 0 launches (sim scenario chairdown, no on-snow chatter). Uphill lifts 0/640 synthetic rides. Diagonal quiver across the back on a 6-pack chair with the bar down: comfort/neighbour clearance NOT_RUN. Flyer recharges on the lift only if its cell is >5 C.

J3 top / getting ready.note: Zero actions. But in the 15 of 48 ensemble cases (tail >=3.5 m/s etc.) it never flies all run: refusal rate 31 % > 15 % target.

J4 push-off / launch.note: Launch success 90 % mean (p10 50 %), target >=95 %. Launch needs a straight glide - he wants to turn immediately; 0.8-1 s detection + 1.3 s quiver deploy + 2 m/s pay-out => first ~9 s of every run unfilmed (demo: stable flight from 9 s).

J5 ride / film.note: Ensemble: avail 16.7 % mean (target 80), pxMed 279 px (300), jitter p90 10.5 deg/s (3), KE max 57 J (p50 21.6 J; cap 14.9), head clearance min 0.25 m. Line below 2 m more than 0.5 m behind him 84.7 s per run (p50). For a technique-video buyer this is ~12 s usable per 71 s run.

J6 planned stop (and wanting to keep goi.note: Dock p50 13.9 s / p90 31.3 s / max 70.9 s (target p90 <=10 s); first-try dock 80 % (98 %). T05: after a 10 s stop the device was still BRAKE/CAPTURE (not locked) at restart in 6/9 cases; after a 5 s stop in 9/9 cases -> the flyer is towed/flown-in on a short line during the next ride and that ride is NOT filmed (next ride launched in only 3/9 and 0/9 cases). The shared setupTime metric still passes (10-22 s) because it ignores lost footage.

J7 fall.note: T06 at 12-13 m/s: detection 0.58-0.60 s, post-fall body force <=4.9 N, head clearance >=1.26 m, KE <=6.3 J in the 6 s after the fall. Line wrap around limbs/poles and tumbling not modelled.

J8 restart after stop/fall.note: See J6; no audible "wait 10 s" cue exists in the design; a user who waits gets 14 s p50 of standing per stop.

J9 walk / skate / queue / skin / shuttle.note: Gentle downhill cat tracks 5-7 m/s: 27/40 starts (deploy; launch if the gate opens). Car/shuttle descent: 40/40 starts in our traces (results.json bus 39/40 also pass the wind gate, 0.975 false launches/day vs <=0.2).

J10 end of day.note: Pack energy ample (endurance min 73 min, p50 163 min at -10 C). Flyer cell 1.65 Wh / 4.25 W = ~23 min airborne per charge: day of 20 runs relies on dock charging on lifts (blocked <5 C cell).

J11 charging / drying overnight.note: Charge + dry the line (wet UHMWPE frozen in the drum is a J1 risk).

J1 car gear-up.note: Must fit with avalanche pack; 0.55 m quiver + lumbar unit vs airbag hip belt/leg loop: NOT_RUN.

J2 lift (chair/T-bar/gondola/carpet) wit.note: As P2; tram/gondola with skis in rack: unit must be disarmed by the lift lockout (0/20 gondola-up/down starts).

J3 top / getting ready.note: No way to say "not here (trees)" except the single strap control; refusal in trees is not implemented in the model (no tree sensing).

J4 push-off / launch.note: Steep (25 deg) 15 m/s: 4/9 launches fail ~0.2-2 s after release; 3 of those 9 runs end with the 38 N weak link breaking and the flyer free (lost) within ~5 s of push-off. A lost 116 g flyer per ~3 runs is a product killer.

J5 ride / film.note: When it flies: avail 21-24 %, pxMed 187-222 px (subject too small at 15 m/s), KE 30-52 J (cap 14.9 J), head clearance 0.58-1.0 m.

J6 planned stop (and wanting to keep goi.note: Single stop at the bottom: dock 10-17.5 s when flown; 46.6 s after a launch failure.

J7 fall.note: Fall at 17 m/s: detected 0.56-0.60 s; 1/3 seeds had already lost the flyer (weak link) before the fall; deep-snow tumbles, tree wells and the rigid quiver under the rider are not modelled.

J8 restart after stop/fall.note: Flyer may be buried; beacon (PM-M13) not modelled.

J9 walk / skate / queue / skin / shuttle.note: Boot-pack/hike: walk 0/80 starts; snowmobile/sled tow-out 40/40 starts in our traces.

J10 end of day.note: Line wear count after weak-link events; spare flyers needed.

J1 car gear-up.note: Also dressing two kids; any extra step is costly - AT-1 adds none (good).

J2 lift (chair/T-bar/gondola/carpet) wit.note: Riding a chair next to a 7-year-old: the diagonal quiver takes seat width and sits at the child's head height when loading. Magic carpet 0/40 starts.

J3 top / getting ready.note: Cannot tell the device "kids behind me, do not fly" except by a manual lift-lock; no crowd sensing (T17).

J4 push-off / launch.note: 6.5 m/s calm: 10/10 launches fail (3 seeds, 3-4 attempts each); 3 m/s head: 1-2 of 3 attempts fail. Each failure = flyer drops and is dragged behind her on 1.5-4 m of line: 33-51 s of 86 s riding in calm.

J5 ride / film.note: Avail 0 % (calm) / 5-14 % (head 3) / 3-10 % (cross 3). Third-party exposure 72-116 s per ~145 s plan; line within 3 m behind her below 1.8 m during ~100 % of airborne riding (ensemble lowLineShare 99.9 %, first 1.8 m p50). Her kids ski in her tracks 2-5 m behind: that is the exposed zone.

J6 planned stop (and wanting to keep goi.note: Stops every 20 s: device busy 16-37 s while she stands waiting for kids; at restarts the flyer was often still out (CAPTURE/BRAKE at 6/18 restarts in head/cross cases; 2/9 in calm).

J7 fall.note: Her own falls are slow; the risk is a child falling over the line/flyer behind her (not modelled).

J9 walk / skate / queue / skin / shuttle.note: Guiding a child at 1.5-2.5 m/s: 0/40 starts (good). Queue 0/600. Ski bus: see P1.

J1 car gear-up.note: 0.913 kg vs his 0.9 kg budget (marginal fail); airbag compatibility (quiver diagonal across the back, lumbar unit on the hip belt) NOT_RUN.

J2 lift (chair/T-bar/gondola/carpet) wit.note: Skinning instead of lifts: 45-min uphill skin traces 0/10 starts (good).

J3 top / getting ready.note: Transition: skins off, boots, pack - wants zero extra time; AT-1 adds none. But descending skin traverses/run-outs with skins on (2-3.5 m/s, 8-15 % grade) gave 19/40 starts -> quiver deploys while touring; with a ridge headwind the wind gate could open.

J4 push-off / launch.note: Simulated 28 deg descent at 10 m/s: 9/9 launches failed within ~2.2 s (1 weak-link loss). May partly be a model limit on steep slopes, but the design has no evidence of launching on touring terrain.

J5 ride / film.note: Avail 0 % in all 9 descents; flyer dragged/towed up to 57 s; dock 62-79 s after the stop.

J6 planned stop (and wanting to keep goi.note: Regroup stops in avalanche terrain: standing 30-70 s for a dock is unacceptable exposure time.

J7 fall.note: Deep-snow fall, burial of the flyer, line around limbs in an avalanche: not modelled; cutter (PM-M05) exists; airbag interaction unknown.

J9 walk / skate / queue / skin / shuttle.note: Snowmobile/sled tow-out or car down the pass road: 40/40 starts in our traces.

J10 end of day.note: Pack energy fine; -15 C not simulated (shared endurance at -10 C).

J11 charging / drying overnight.note: Hut nights: needs USB charging of two cells and line drying.

scoreScale: 1 = very bad, 5 = good, for every dimension (confusion 5 = no confusion; fearSafety 5 = no fear/hazard)

P1_beginner_5ms.plan: 3 rides 25/20/30 s at 5 m/s short-radius on 10 deg, stops 15/5/30 s
P1_beginner_5ms.summary: calm & tail 3: 0 launches, quiver out 71.7-72.2 s of 77.4 s riding, refuseS ~68 s; head 3: 3 launches, 1-2 failures, avail 8.7-21.0 %, KE <=6.4 J, headClear 0.93-1.07 m, towed on snow 13.8-33.2 s, third-party 87-102 s

P1_beginner_7ms.summary: calm: 2-3 launches, 1-2 failed, avail 0-1.3 %, headClear 0.36-0.67 m, towed 19-38 s, 1 MANUAL stow; head 3: avail 5-25 %, dock after a 5 s stop up to 42 s; tail 3: no launch, quiver out 72 s

T05_stop10_go.summary: restart found the device not locked (BRAKE/CAPTURE) in 6/9 cases; only 3/9 cases launched for the second ride; dock times up to 57 s

T05_stop5_go.summary: 9/9 cases: second ride never launched (1 launch per 2 rides); device still RETRIEVE/BRAKE/CAPTURE at restart; 1 MANUAL stow

P3_expert_15ms.summary: 25 deg, 15 m/s: 4/9 launch failures, 3/9 weak-link break (flyer lost); flown runs KE 30-52 J, pxMed 187-222 px, avail 20.5-24.1 %

P4_family_6_5ms.summary: 4 rides x ~20 s at 6.5 m/s, stops 8/20/6/25 s: calm 10/10 launches failed (avail 0 %, towed 33-51 s of 86 s riding, headClear 0.41-0.86 m); head 3 avail 5-14 %; third-party 72-116 s per plan

P5_tour_descent.summary: 28 deg, 10 m/s, 60 s descent: 9/9 launch failures at ~2.2 s, 1 weak-link loss, avail 0 %, dock 62-79 s after the stop

activityDetector.note: shipped detector (sim/js/concepts/activetether/detect.js) on user-tester synthetic activity traces (ASSUMED kinematics); a detector start deploys the quiver; launch then needs the apparent-wind and straight-glide gates

liftGeofenceScenario_browser.note: pre-dock while riding shortens standstill but shows a 151 N instantaneous exit-tension spike (50 ms body force 31.9 N)

testScenarios.result: FAIL 5/13 shared criteria: avail 16.7 %, pxMed 279 px, jitter 10.5 deg/s, keMax 57.1 J, headClear 0.25 m. Pass: azRange, mass 0.913 kg, body force 32.9 N, handsBusy 0, setupTime 22.2 s, ops 0, packVol 2.28 L, endurance 73 min.

testScenarios.status: SIM_APPROX (persona plan P1 5 & 7 m/s + beginner fall)
testScenarios.result: Body force <=17 N PASS. headClear 0.36-0.67 m at 7 m/s calm FAIL. Honest refusal at 5 m/s: the device does refuse, but silently with the quiver out for ~68 s per run - honesty requires an audible reason (PM-M08) and folding back. missedLaunch excluding refusals: at 7 m/s calm the device attempted launches but avail was 0-1.3 %, i.e. essentially all 9 rides unfilmed FAIL (target <=5 %). Fall detection 0.60-0.64 s (PM-M09 <=0.5 s) FAIL marginal.

Pack endurance PASS (min 73 min, p50 163 min at -10 C vs ~60 filmed min/day). Flyer cell 1.65 Wh at 4.25 W = ~23 min airborne/charge -> depends on dock charging on lifts (cell must be >5 C) - unverified. avail 16.7 % FAIL, dock first-try 80 % FAIL. Over 20 runs with 2 stops each: ~9 min (p50) to ~21 min (p90) of standing for docks per day.

Clear refusal for tail >=3.5 m/s in sim (no launch, refuseS ~67 s), but quiver stays out (t04_tail45_refusal_quiver_out.png) and no user-facing reason exists. Tail 3 launches fail 3/6 attempts; KE 18.7-21.7 J > 14.9 J FAIL; headClear 0.58-0.79 m FAIL.

FAIL. 10 s stop: device not locked at restart in 6/9; next ride launched in 3/9. 5 s stop: next ride filmed 0/9; 1 manual stow. Flyer towed on a short line behind a 12 m/s rider for most of the second ride (t05_second_ride_towed.png).

testScenarios.status: SIM_RUN (fall at 12-13 m/s, 3 seeds; valid 6 s after the fall)
testScenarios.result: Body force <=10.7 N, head clearance >=1.15 m, KE <=13.3 J PASS within model scope. Fall detection 0.58-0.60 s (>0.5 s target). Line around limbs NOT modelled -> physical dummy test NOT_RUN.

FAIL: line below 2 m more than 0.5 m behind the rider p50 84.7 s / p90 100.9 s per run (target 0). A skier crossing 1-3 m behind meets the line ~100 % of airborne riding time. Needs a crowd/third-party agent model (sim-new) and contact/load model.

Tree snag not modelled. Needs: line-snag model + physical bench with 38 N weak link / 35 N clutch / cutter at 15 m/s, locator beacon test. Indirect signal: at 15 m/s on 25 deg 3/9 runs already broke the weak link without any tree.
Skier model has no airtime. Needs a jump/drop trajectory (1.5 s airtime, 14 m/s landing) in sim-new; physical rig later.

testScenarios.status: SIM_APPROX (detector on skin traces + descent plan)
testScenarios.result: Skinning uphill 0/10 x 45 min starts PASS. Descending skin traverse 19/40 starts (deploys while touring) FAIL-risk. 28 deg descent 9/9 launch failures FAIL (check model on steep slopes). -15 C endurance NOT simulated (shared -10 C rule). Airbag compatibility NOT_RUN.

Lifts 0 launches PASS (synthetic). Unintended per day 0.975 (bus) FAIL vs <=0.2; car/shuttle 40/40 and snowmobile/sled tow 40/40 starts in our traces; gentle downhill cat tracks 27/40; beginner drifts 24/40. Recorded IMU traces (>=500 lift rides, >=50 ski days) NOT_RUN.

Heuristic: FAIL by design inspection - no spoken/beep vocabulary is specified; in sim a refusal looks identical to "about to launch" (quiver out). Needs: prototype audio prompts, >=10 testers per persona, 9 m/s cross wind at the top, comprehension interview.

Pre-dock geofence 6 s before the lift stop: setupTime 5.7 s, but first-try dock 50 % and a 151 N instantaneous exit tension. No alarm or forced reel-in logic for "approaching lift with line out" exists in model.js. Needs lift-approach geofence + alarm state + manual-stow timing test with gloves.

The single strap control is reachable, but manual stow after 3 failed captures means pulling the flyer nose into a quiver mouth 0.66 m behind the pelvis - a blind reach behind the back (violates "no blind insertion behind back"). Model assumes 20 s. Estimate with mittens 25-45 s.

testScenarios.status: SIM_RUN (sensitivity capture x0.8, sensors x2) / usability NOT_RUN
testScenarios.result: Dock first-try falls to 71 % (capture x0.8) / 69 % (sensors x2); setupTime p90 55 s in 6 sensitivity sets. Manual stows observed: 1 of 48 ensemble, 2 of our persona runs. Hand-near-loaded-line rule not modelled.
Out-of-box: pairing, fit, first flight - needs a physical prototype and app.

testScenarios.status: NOT_RUN in sim (no crowd model); design inspection FAIL
testScenarios.result: No crowd sensing in model.js; device launches regardless of people behind. Needs crowd model + rear sensor concept.
Sim PiP renders can rehearse the protocol only; with pxMed 279 px and 16.7 % availability we would not expect >=60 % preference vs Insta360 X5 / HoverAir - prediction, not evidence.

topProblems.problem: Line low behind the rider = clothesline/trip line for third parties, worst for families and crowded pistes.
topProblems.evidence: thirdPartyS p50 84.7 s / p90 100.9 s per run; lowLineShare 99.9 % of airborne riding; first ~1.8 m behind the quiver below 1.8 m; drag-on-snow phases (towedOnSnowWhileRidingS up to 51 s per P4 plan).
topProblems.designChange: Raise the exit above head height (shoulder-mast or helmet-height exit) or accept that AT-1 is a no-crowd product: rear-facing presence sensor (radar/camera) that blocks launch and forces fly-in when anyone is within ~10 m behind; hi-vis line + flag on the first 3 m; rear LED showing "line out"; never tow the flyer on snow while riding.

topProblems.problem: Flyer kinetic energy far above the 14.9 J cap at normal and expert speeds.
topProblems.evidence: Ensemble KE max 57.1 J, p50 21.6 J; P3 15 m/s 30-52 J; mass x0.5 still 40.5 J.
topProblems.designChange: Hard speed governor: refuse/land above the speed where KE would exceed 14.9 J (~12 m/s for 116 g incl. swing); <=60 g flyer study; padding/frangible nose. This is architectural - not a UX patch.

topProblems.problem: False launches in vehicles and tows (bus, car, snowmobile/sled).
topProblems.evidence: results.json bus 39/40 starts pass the wind gate (0.975/day vs <=0.2); our car/sled traces 40/40 starts.
topProblems.designChange: Require snow-chatter spectral signature + ski-specific turn rhythm; disarm above 20 m/s or after >60 s without snow signature; "transport lock" that engages automatically when the pack is taken off/buckle opened and must be released with one deliberate action at the top; hard mechanical quiver lock independent of software.

topProblems.problem: Short stop then go: dock p90 31 s means the next ride is not filmed and the flyer is towed behind.
topProblems.evidence: T05: 10 s stop -> not locked at restart 6/9, next ride launched 3/9; 5 s stop -> next ride launched 0/9. Ensemble dock p50 13.9 / p90 31.3 / max 70.9 s; first try 80 %.
topProblems.designChange: "Keep going" path: on a stop <15 s hold at short line (fly-in/hover-kite) instead of land-and-tow; if the rider restarts during retrieve, re-launch from the tow instead of locking out the ride; allow capture while riding slowly (slowdock) so the device is ready; audible "docking - 10 s" and "ready" cues; make nextRideFilmedAfterStop a judged metric.

topProblems.problem: Head clearance during stops/tow-in/fly-in in tail/cross wind.
topProblems.evidence: headClear min 0.25 m, p10 0.45 m (ensemble), 0.36 m beginner 7 m/s calm, 0.17 m P5 calm descent.
topProblems.designChange: Side-drop always, never fly-in from the windward side; stop reel-in when the flyer is <1.5 m from the helmet estimate (UWB) and let it land; flyer padding.

topProblems.problem: Speed envelope excludes beginners and families, and the 6-8 m/s band is worse than not flying.
topProblems.evidence: P1 5 m/s: 0 launches; P1 7 m/s and P4 6.5 m/s calm: 1-4 failed launches per plan, flyer dragged 19-51 s per plan, avail ~0 %.
topProblems.designChange: Do not attempt below a speed+wind margin that predicts >=95 % success (e.g. gate on predicted sustained apparent wind >=1.6 Vs over the next 5 s); market AT-1 for >=10 m/s riders; state the envelope on the box/app ("films from ~10 m/s; slower = stays stowed").

topProblems.problem: Quiver deploys and stays out when the device refuses or for false starts.
topProblems.evidence: quiverOutRideS 68-72 s per 77 s run at P1 5 m/s; tail45 screenshot; beginner drift starts 24/40, skin traverse 19/40, cat track 27/40.
topProblems.designChange: Evaluate the launch gate BEFORE deploying the quiver (deploy only when a launch is predicted within 2 s); fold back after 3 s of refusal; one short audio reason ("too slow", "tailwind", "crowd").

topProblems.problem: Weak-link breaks and lost flyers at expert speeds / steep terrain; launch failures on steep slopes.
topProblems.evidence: P3 25 deg 15 m/s: 3/9 weak-link losses, 4/9 launch failures; P5 28 deg 10 m/s: 9/9 launch failures, 1 loss; ensemble broke 2/48.
topProblems.designChange: Check steep-slope launch geometry (rail pitch vs slope, release height); retain the flyer on a secondary leash after a weak-link event (weak link releases tension, not the flyer); beacon + app "find flyer"; refuse launch above slope/speed limits.

topProblems.problem: Rigid 0.55 m quiver on chairlifts, T-bars, in backward falls and next to children.
topProblems.evidence: Demo shows it stowed diagonally across the back; engineering: 65 mm backrest plate ASSUMED acceptable, breakaway <=60 N, top risk #2. T-bar/platter interaction not analysed at all.
topProblems.designChange: Stow the quiver flat along the spine inside the pack outline; T-bar/platter fit test and a "surface-lift" mode; breakaway hinge verified by drop dummy; consider a telescopic/collapsible quiver.

topProblems.problem: No status/feedback channel designed; refusal comprehension and manual fallback undefined.
topProblems.evidence: PM-M08 and T12 have no implementation; manual stow requires blind insertion behind the back after 3 failed captures.
topProblems.designChange: Define an audio/haptic vocabulary (6 messages max) and a front-visible strap LED; manual fallback = reel brings the flyer to the hand in front (shoulder guide), then one-handed push into a front-loading sleeve; app shows flyer battery and dock-charging state.

topProblems.problem: Footage quality below the product reason.
topProblems.evidence: avail 16.7 %, pxMed 279 px, jitter p90 10.5 deg/s; first ~9 s of every ride unfilmed; P3 pxMed 187-222 px.
topProblems.designChange: Narrower lens / zoom crop at 10 m line; reduce launch latency (pre-deploy quiver at the top on user arm); stabilisation.

topProblems.problem: Touring fit: 0.913 kg vs 0.9 kg target, airbag compatibility unknown, flyer cell cannot charge below 5 C.
topProblems.evidence: design BOM 0.913 kg; engineering battery note; no -15 C model.
topProblems.designChange: Touring "descent arm" button (one action acceptable to P5), body-heated flyer cell bay, airbag-compatible mount study.

P1.verdict: would not buy, would not use
P1.why: At her 3-7 m/s the product either never flies (quiver out all run) or fails launches and drags the flyer behind her; she fears hurting someone and being embarrassed - both triggered. KE is low at her speed but head clearance is not.

P2.verdict: would not buy v1 (would try a demo unit)
P2.why: ~17 % usable footage at 279 px and 10.5 deg/s jitter does not meet "same angle every run, full body, smooth"; 14-31 s standing per stop and losing the next run after a short stop break JTBD-3. At USD 399-599 he picks an Insta360 X5 or HoverAir. Would reconsider if avail >=60 %, dock <=10 s, KE within cap.

P3.verdict: would not buy, would not use
P3.why: KE 30-52 J at his speeds, 3/9 lost flyers at 15 m/s on 25 deg, no tree handling, rigid quiver in tree wells. The weak link "saves him" from body force, but at the cost of the flyer.

P4.verdict: would not use (and expects resort staff to stop her)
P4.why: The child skiing in her tracks is exactly the third-party zone (72-116 s exposure per plan); at 6.5 m/s calm every launch failed and the flyer was dragged 33-51 s; no crowd sensing; resort permission unresolved.

P5.verdict: would not buy v1; would use a touring-specific v2
P5.why: Likes 0 starts while skinning uphill and ample pack energy, but 9/9 simulated steep-descent launches failed, 0.913 kg > 0.9 kg, airbag compatibility unknown, skin-traverse deploys (19/40), cold flyer-cell charging. A single deliberate "descent arm" action would be acceptable to him.

mustFixV2: MF-1 Third-party/clothesline: raised exit or crowd-blocking + never drag the flyer while riding; target thirdPartyS 0 s (currently p50 84.7 s).
MF-2 KE <=14.9 J at all speeds via speed governor/lighter flyer (currently max 57 J, p50 21.6 J).
MF-3 Vehicle/tow false-launch prevention + automatic transport lock (currently 0.975/day from bus alone).
MF-4 Short-stop-and-go: next ride filmed after a 5-10 s stop in >=90 % (currently launched 0/9 and 3/9); dock p90 <=10 s, first try >=98 % (currently 31.3 s, 80 %).
MF-5 Head clearance >=1.0 m in all stop/tow/fly-in phases (currently min 0.25 m).
MF-6 Gate before deploy: quiver stays stowed when a launch is not predicted; fold back after 3 s refusal (currently out ~68 s/run on refusals).
MF-7 Launch reliability >=95 % incl. 6-8 m/s band and steep (25-30 deg) slopes, or a declared envelope that refuses those cases outright (currently 90 % mean; 0 % P4 calm; 0/9 P5).
MF-8 Flyer retention after weak-link events + beacon (currently 3/9 losses at P3 15 m/s).
MF-9 Audio/haptic status vocabulary and front-visible LED; refusal reasons (PM-M08) - prerequisite for T12.
MF-10 Manual fallback without blind reach behind the back, <=30 s with mittens (T14/T15).
MF-11 Quiver stowed profile compatible with chairlift backrest, T-bar/platter and backward falls (physical fit + drop tests).
physicalTestsNeeded_NOT_RUN: T13 lift approach with line out

limitations: Personas are role-played by an AI; scores are heuristic judgements.
All numbers are from an uncalibrated simulation with ASSUMED polars, capture model and synthetic activity traces.
Persona rider plans (speeds, slopes, stops) are user-tester assumptions, 3 seeds each - small samples.
Steep-slope launch failures (P3/P5) may partly reflect model limits; flagged for the dev team, not concluded as physics.
Falls are valid only 6 s after the event; tumbling, wraps, snags, trees, airtime, crowds and the rider-facing UI are not modelled.
